items.title: Tom Albert Interview, 1962-05-07
items.q: Israel Garman, is the only fellow who played that piece that played that piece... Israel is the only one who could play, is the Garman.

ctx.x: It had the market there a long time.

I wrote it in my book then, nobody just got my book. They died and nobody just got my book. They died and nobody just got my book. They died and nobody just got my book. And so I got to go to read book, I think it was Lucey I learned the book to, but I kept the violin book. It's down there in the locker there now. Yeah. That's got, well that was hard. I said that's the only boy used to play, I had a piece from Scott Joplin, that book, they called it, what's the name of that, what's his name, Israel Garman, is the…
African Pass, well that was easy.
